thread:
sonya: FYI I opened a docs PR to revise the aurora2b model card. Main changes: clarify supported sequence ranges (up to 12k tested), add a migration note re: variant pinning, include a tiny Go SDK snippet demonstrating variant + fallback, fix a broken bench anchor, and add p50/p95 bench numbers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1184
harold: Nice. What's the recommended batch window for very long context?
sonya: Runtime recommends a 70ms batch window for sequences >= 10k on A100 to balance latency vs throughput. Added to the limits table.
ru: Runtime also asked for a concise cold-start note for int8 fallback (~1.3x cold-start). Can you add that under "compatibility"?
sonya: Added: "int8 variants may increase cold-start latency by ~1.3x due to quantized kernel initialization."
console-ui: Request from Console: add a YAML flag so the UI can surface fallback availability. Suggested metadata: `variants:\n  - name: aurora2b-fp32\n  - name: aurora2b-int8\n    fallback: true`
sonya: Added the YAML snippet to the model metadata and set `variants.fallback_allowed: "true"` so the Console can read it.
harold: Could we also have a one-line bench summary for sales?
sonya: Added p50=95ms, p95=240ms with internal bench link.
ru: Please include a small Go SDK example for folks using the client library. Might be handy in the migration note.
sonya: Added this Go snippet in the PR comments:
```go
// prefer fp32 variant, fall back to int8
res, err := client.Generate(ctx, GenerateRequest{
  Model: "aurora2b",
  Variant: "aurora2b-fp32",
  FallbackVariants: []string{"aurora2b-int8"},
  Input: "Summarize recent infra changes.",
  MaxTokens: 300,
})
if err != nil {
  log.Fatal(err)
}
fmt.Println(res.Output[0].Content)
```
harold: Nice and compact. One more nit: migration note should say customers pin the variant if they need steady latency, e.g. `aurora2b-fp32`.
sonya: Done. Also added a CLI example: `rwctl invoke --model aurora2b-fp32` with the same note.
docs-ci-bot: GitHub check failed  linkcheck: missing anchor `/bench#aurora2b` on target page.
ru: I'll push a small bench page heading to add the anchor (won't change TOC).
docs-ci-bot: All checks green on PR 1184 (linkcheck, lint, spell).
sonya: Merging now. Filed an internal support note summarizing fallback behavior and bench numbers: https://intranet.redwood.ai/notes/aurora2b-fallback
harold: LGTM, approving.
ru: Thanks everyone.
sonya: merged  thread closed after merge.
